boundaries.name: \Gamma_H
boundaries.description: central segment of the bottom edge through which hot flue gas injects heat by convection (hot-fluid side)

boundaries.name: \Gamma_a
boundaries.description: adiabatic remainder of the bottom edge outside the hot-gas footprint

boundaries.name: \Gamma_p
boundaries.description: isothermal water-wall (cooling-pipe) heat sink at prescribed temperature u_C, the zero of the temperature scale

boundaries.name: \Gamma_c
boundaries.description: duct edges exchanging heat with ambient air (left and right edges)

objective.name: J
objective.description: material cost plus heat-flux-weighted gas-side surface-temperature integral; minimizing keeps the gas-side surface cold at fixed material cost, maximizing heat recovered from the flue gas

state_equation.description: linear heat-conduction problem with Robin convection on \Gamma_H and \Gamma_c and Dirichlet u = u_C on \Gamma_p
state_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{D} k \chi \left( \nabla u \cdot \nabla \delta u \right) \,dx + \int_{\Gamma_H} h_H u \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_c} h u \delta u \,ds_x
state_equation.weak_form_rhs: \int_{\Gamma_H} h_H u_{H} \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_c} h u_{amb} \delta u \,ds_x

adjoint_equation.description: adjoint problem with homogeneous Dirichlet condition \tilde u = 0 on \Gamma_p and adjoint load from the gas-side surface-temperature integral in the objective
adjoint_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{D} k \chi \left( \nabla \delta u \cdot \nabla \tilde u \right) \,dx + \int_{\Gamma_H} h_H \delta u \tilde u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_c} h \delta u \tilde u \,ds_x

boundaries.name: \Gamma_H
boundaries.description: central segment of the bottom edge through which hot flue gas injects heat by convection (hot-fluid side)

boundaries.name: \Gamma_a
boundaries.description: adiabatic remainder of the bottom edge outside the hot-gas footprint (zero-load Neumann, i.e. perfectly insulated)

boundaries.name: \Gamma_p
boundaries.description: isothermal water-wall (cooling-pipe) heat sink at prescribed temperature u_C, the zero of the temperature scale

boundaries.name: \Gamma_c
boundaries.description: duct edges exchanging heat with ambient air (left and right edges)

designed.interfaces_rationale: Single-domain problem: the whole duct is one computational domain D, so there is no material interface between two computational domains. The only internal boundary is the solid/void (level-set) boundary, which carries mesh label 10 and is handled implicitly by the level-set function, not as a multi-domain interface.

fields.name: u
fields.rationale: Two-dimensional steady heat-conduction temperature field; the LaTeX Dirichlet boundary name \Gamma_p is reconciled with the mesh label 4 (isothermal water wall). P2 and unit K are preserved from the extracted spec.

expressions.name: \mathbf n
expressions.rationale: Outward unit normal of the level-set interface; needed both for the interface advection and for the (V . n) factor in the boundary term of the shape derivative.

expressions.name: \kappa
expressions.rationale: Curvature of the movable ambient-air boundary \Gamma_c; it appears explicitly in the extracted boundary part of the shape derivative, so it must be available as an evaluable expression.

expressions.name: k(\phi)
expressions.rationale: Effective conductivity of the two-phase (solid aluminium / air void) medium obtained by interpolating the two conductivities through the level-set Heaviside; reproduces the k\chi factor used in the state, adjoint and shape-derivative forms.

expressions.name: \mathbf q
expressions.rationale: Fourier heat-flux density, the standard derived quantity of the thermal problem; useful for post-processing the recovered heat flux.

characteristic_function.rationale: chi is the material indicator (1 in solid aluminium, chi_weak in air); the weak value is kept as extracted (it is the regularised void fraction of the level-set formulation).

extra_params.note: ell is the Lagrange multiplier that trades the material-cost term against the heat-recovery term of J; it is deliberately left undesigned because the pipeline calibrates it in the Afac-calibration step.

optimization_config.rationale: The extracted spec fixes the geometry convention (unit-square duct, I-beam initial layout given by phi_0) but supplies no numerical optimisation settings, so they are designed here: hmin/hmax resolve the level set at 1/100-1/10 of the unit-square domain; diffusion 1e-4 regularises the Hamilton-Jacobi update; v0 = 1e-3 moves the solid/void interface by about 5% of the domain over 30 iterations, small enough to keep the linearised shape derivative valid; 30 iterations lie in the recommended 20-50 range. boundary_labels/fixed_labels follow the extracted design roles: only the ambient-air Robin edge \Gamma_c (label 3) is movable, whereas the adiabatic bottom remainder (1), the hot-gas footprint (2) and the isothermal water wall (4) are prescribed by the device layout and frozen. The solid/void boundary (mesh label 10) is never listed: it is carried implicitly by the level-set function.
